integrity.claim_scope: one-sweep image language/count and image entropy only
integrity.domain: labelled periodic binary rings length n >=3; fixed left-to-right in-place scan
integrity.methods: constructive inverse criterion; 12-state Boolean relation monoid; exact integer matrix identity
integrity.original_rule: Wolfram elementary Rule 30, f(l,c,r)=l XOR (c OR r)

scientific_limitations: Only labelled cyclic binary rings of length at least three, one deterministic in-place increasing-index sweep.
No statement for arbitrary update orders, simultaneous dynamics, long-time or stochastic evolution.
Finite verification of all inputs through length 16 supplements rather than replaces the all-length Boolean-matrix proof.
Historical priority could change if unindexed or inaccessible earlier source material contains an equivalent result.
title: Exact one-sweep reachability and image entropy of sequential Rule 30
